pythonFunction.name: send_info_link
pythonFunction.description:
Texts or emails the customer a link to a Washington Gas page, so a voice caller can see the details after
the call. Topics: rebates, rebates_dc, rebate_tracking, payment_options, payment_plans, assistance,
budget_plan_and_autopay, start_stop, bill_charges, safety, bill_tips, appliance_safety, home_repair_plans, my_account. Needs an identified caller. Before calling this
tool, speak a brief conversational pacing phrase while it runs.

Args:
    account_id: Leave empty: the identified account is used automatically (any other id is refused).
    topic: One of the topics above (REQUIRED).
    channel: sms or email; leave empty to use sms when a mobile number is on file, else email.
    tenant: Injected by the system from tenant_id; leave empty.

Returns:
    dict with ok, topic, channel, destination_hint (last four digits of the number, or the masked email)
    and page (the page title).
